sentence_stem: Although the poem seems simple at first,
correct_completion: its hidden meaning only becomes clear after several careful readings.
full_sentence: Although the poem seems simple at first, its hidden meaning only becomes clear after several careful readings.
acceptable_variants: its deeper message is revealed only on a second reading.
most readers miss its true meaning the first time.

options.text: so I stopped reading it after one line.
options.why_wrong: 'So' expresses a result, which does not fit after 'although'. The sentence needs a clause that contrasts with the first part.

options.text: because the poem has a very short title.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a cause, but 'although' introduces a concession. This clause also does not contrast with the idea that the poem seems simple.

options.text: its hidden meaning only becomes clear after several careful readings.
and the poem has three lines.
options.why_wrong: This adds a neutral fact but does not set up a contrast with the idea that the poem seems simple.

explanation: After 'although', the second clause must contrast with the first. Here the poem looks simple, so the completion must show that its real meaning is hidden. Learners sometimes choose a clause with 'so' or 'because', which express result or cause rather than concession.
translation: Chociaż wiersz na początku wydaje się prosty, jego ukryte znaczenie staje się jasne dopiero po kilku uważnych czytaniach.
